title: Wartales F5 header-search index artifact
description: Published contract for site/public/data/search/{locale}.json and manifest.json (spec-f5-search §3). Emitted by pipeline/tools/search_index_emit.py as run_all.ps1 stage `emit` step 3. Derived, disposable artifact (FRAMEWORK §2.1/§2.9): membership = namedLocales verbatim, names = overlay values verbatim (markup included), hrefs composed at emit time from the declared route table below. Deterministic: fixed key order (rows kind,id,name,href; top level schema,locale,buildId,rows), ensure_ascii=False UTF-8 LF, no clock, buildId is the only freshness stamp.

searchableKinds.description: SEARCHABLE_KINDS frozen in the emitter; asserted ⊆ wave_kinds.MANAGED_KINDS (40 kinds) there, == manifest.kinds here, == TS KIND_ORDER in site/src/lib/search/searchRows.ts. Growth lands with wave-2 overlays per spec-f5 §2's recount-and-refreeze law.

routeTable.description: derived-from-F2-§6 (frozen URL law): entity pages WITHOUT a /db prefix; pivot composes bare (DR-2026-08-20-locale-urls); segments are F4 §2's lowercase page-plane ids — client codes never leak into hrefs where the segment differs. A rename of F2 §6 propagates as this table edit plus a rerun, never a frontend change.

kind.description: A SEARCHABLE_KINDS member — kind names from wave_kinds, never sheet names.

id.description: Stable game id (avail join key; URL ids verbatim, slugs only additive per F2 §4).

name.description: The game string for that locale, markup included — stripping is a matcher concern (spec-f5 §4.3), never an artifact transform.

href.description: Composed from the routeTable for this file's locale; pivot bare, pt-BR keyed file carries /pt-br/… (never /pt-BR/…); never contains /search. Anchored as ONE group — the r1 alternation parsed as (^A)|(B$), so any string containing /item/<seg>/… validated; fixed in fix round r2 (m-4).

locale.description: DATA-plane client code — the artifact vocabulary (URL segments are presentation-only and appear inside hrefs, not here). ja is community-lane omit-until-translated and never appears.

buildId.description: The extraction freshness stamp (machine plane, D2-compatible); no timestamps anywhere in the artifact.

rows.description: Sorted by (SEARCHABLE_KINDS index, id asc); one row iff locale ∈ namedLocales for that avail row — byte-identical (kind,id) list across all nine files.

kinds.description: == emitter SEARCHABLE_KINDS, order-significant (tie-break + grouping order for the matcher).
